lead: Where to park, who to look for, and how pick-up works at Greene Middle School.

parking.name: Middlefield Parking Lot
parking.how: Enter from Middlefield Road. This is the main lot and the closest one to our classrooms in the C, F, N and P wings.

parking.name: N. California Loop
parking.how: The half-circle driveway in front of the school on North California Avenue. From there, walk east along the front of the school to our wings.

parkingNote: Both are open to families and volunteers on Sundays. Skip any space marked Staff Only, and don’t use disabled spaces without a placard.
volunteers: At the lot entrance, waving cars in and pointing to open spaces
At the crosswalks, helping families walk safely from the lot to campus
At the building doors, pointing students to the right wing
Back out at 1:30 PM for pick-up
pickup: KG through Grade 8: a parent or guardian must come to the classroom to pick up their child.
Youth Group students may leave on their own.
Volunteers and security guards watch the campus at dismissal to keep everyone safe and moving.
Dhuhr prayer is held right after class in the lunch area between the F and G wings. It’s optional.
closedCampus: Students may not leave the Greene campus during school. The only exceptions: a parent or guardian comes to take them, or Youth Group students leave with a chaperone.
greeneRules: Don’t park or stop at red curbs, even for a quick drop-off.
Disabled spaces need a placard. These are enforced with tickets.
No double parking. Pull all the way into a space.
Don’t use the small driveways by the C-Wing, or behind the MPR and tennis courts, for drop-off or pick-up.
Don’t open car doors into the North California bike lane.
sharing: We’re guests at Greene. If there’s another event on campus, like a swim meet, give them their space: park where volunteers direct you and stay out of their area.
